observations: Single photo shows a bare car engine assembly sitting on a concrete/paved surface, apparently removed from a vehicle.
Black plastic engine cover visible with a lattice/mesh pattern, wiring harness and sensors routed around the block.
No visible manufacturer logo, engine code, or casting number legible on the cover or block.
A watermark reading 'TI AUTOMOBILE' is overlaid on the image - this is the seller's shop branding, not a product identifier.
Background shows what looks like a tire/rim and other parts, consistent with a used-parts yard.
No wiring diagram, VIN sticker, dipstick, or any readable plate/sticker that would confirm make or model.
No video or sound to confirm the engine runs; it is shown static on the ground, disconnected from any vehicle or test rig.

read_from: photo 0 - no legible brand, model, or casting number visible

claims.claim: Direct tokumbo engine (implies directly imported, foreign-used, not locally used)
claims.evidence: No import documents, customs paperwork, or distinguishing photo evidence shown; claim rests solely on seller's wording.

risks.risk: Engine make/model unknown, which drives most of the price (a small 4-cylinder vs V6/V8 engine price differs hugely)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the engine block casting number, VIN/engine code sticker, or a shot showing badge/label identifying make and model
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at all without this - price depends entirely on identity

risks.risk: Engine may not run or may have internal damage (not tested)
risks.proof: Video clip of the engine being started and running, ideally with oil pressure/temperature shown

risks.risk: Unknown mileage or history (accident, flood, overheating)
risks.proof: Seller-provided documentation, odometer photo from donor vehicle, or compression test results

risks.risk: Hidden physical damage (cracked block, stripped threads, leaking seals) not visible from this single angle
risks.proof: Multiple close-up photos of all sides of the block, oil pan, and head gasket area
risks.if_unproven: priced as having possible damage until shown undamaged

risks.risk: Claim of 'direct tokumbo' (foreign-used, not Nigerian-used) cannot be confirmed from a photo
risks.proof: Import/clearing documents, shipping photos, or chassis plate showing foreign registration history
risks.if_unproven: treated as unverified origin, no premium for 'direct import' status

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the engine block showing any casting number, engine code, or manufacturer badge
Video of the engine running (start-up, idle, revving) to confirm it functions
Additional photos from multiple angles (front, rear, sides, underside) to check for cracks, leaks, or missing parts
Any documentation showing import origin or donor vehicle details
response.reason: The engine's make and model cannot be read from the single photo, and since engine type is the primary price driver (unlike plain furniture), no worst-case price can be set without that identification.
